description: Solve the Tower 검사 도구. 게임 자체는 이 폴더 없이 동작합니다.

scripts.verify: rm -f .covered-*.json; for f in verify-trig verify-math1-basic verify-math1-extra verify-math1a verify-math1-finish verify-matha-finish verify-math2 verify-explain verify-chains verify-coverage; do echo "== $f"; node $f.mjs | grep -E 'PROBLEM|MISSING|NOT VERIFIED|problems [0-9]+' | cut -c1-300; done
